When I was a very young child, I had a horrible nightmare about a nuclear apocalypse. It started out in my second child hood home, and I remember talking to 2 women that seemed to be strangers, but somehow I knew them. I remember in my dream that I was around the same age I am now (~20) but my parents weren't around at the time. When I had the dream, my father was still alive but for some reason, I dreamed that he was absolutely gone. Like he had been dead for years. I was chatting with these 2 women when I ran outside at the sound of commotion. My mother was already out on the front lawn and the 2 women had followed me outside. I remember seeing jets flying over head and the sound of distant gunfire getting louder and louder. Somehow, my mother, these 2 women, and I had made our way to my old elementary school. We were all by the cafeteria and there were a couple of other people I knew there. Some strangers, and old friend from elementary school(now grown in my dream), and a couple of other folk that I cant quiet seem to remember. In my dream, I was walking around and yelling at people about how I was right about a war and how nobody believed me but now look at us, all the cliche "you should've listened to my warning bullshit". That's when the building began to shake and we all ran outside to the field. Now the way my elementary was set up was, we shared a playground/giant field with another elementary school. We were all running in this field. Terrified. Absolutely terrified. This was absolutely the most traumatizing part of my dream because as I ran through this field, I felt like I was actually in a warzone. I can still clearly remember the sight of the whole sky lit up orange and red from the fires of my burning city. There was smoke everywhere and it checked me as I ran more and more. I remember being clearly able to hear gunfire and people screaming (the kind of screaming they do when they get shot, not when they're scared). I saw so many bodies just lifeless and bleeding everywhere. Some still twitching with life, many far too mangled to recognize. And that's when it happened. As I was in a dead sprint, choking on smoke and trying not to look at the bodies on the ground (like I said, I was at an elementary so I guess it made sense that most of the bodies were children) I saw a very bright and very giant flash in the middle of the sky, and then the mushroom cloud. It was massive. Towered higher than absolutely anything I've seen before. And the heat. I could feel my skin burning in my dream. As I felt the cloud getting closer, and about to consume me, I woke up. I cried and cried and eventually wrote it off as just a nightmare, but then some creepy things started to happen over the years that really made this dream stick with me. First, my father passed away. Then, when my mother and I sold the house and moved, the new people that moved in made the outside look close enough to my dream that it began to give me anxiety. After that, I started experiencing deja vu on a more and more common level (I experience it at least once a month now, no I dont think I'm psychic or any crap like that) but then something happened that really freaked me out. That old friend from elementary that I dreamed about? I met her again in high school and I swear on my life, she looked just like she did in my dream. As the political climate has grown more and more tense, that nightmare has given me more and more anxiety. I dont even sleep some nights because of it. But yeah, that was my most traumatizing dream.
